title: Aurora hero
description: Centered hero with a drifting aurora, dotted backdrop, announcement pill and staggered copy.

title: Globe split hero
description: Split hero with copy, CTAs and live stats beside an interactive dotted globe with arcs.

title: Product screenshot hero
description: Centered headline above a dashboard in a browser frame with a border beam and a logo row.

title: Phone split hero
description: App launch hero with an email capture on the left and an app screen in an iPhone frame.

title: Wavy hero
description: Bold centered hero over flowing waves, with a rotating headline word and avatar social proof.

title: Developer tool hero
description: Minimal hero on a retro grid with a typed headline accent, an install terminal and two CTAs.

title: Bento feature grid

title: Icon feature grid

title: Tabbed product tour

title: Alternating screenshot rows

title: Numbered steps

title: Single plan pricing
description: One all-inclusive plan card beside a benefit list and short reassurance answers.

title: Pricing comparison table
description: Grouped feature comparison table with a sticky plan header, and per-plan tabs on mobile.

title: Testimonial marquee
description: Two rows of review cards scrolling in opposite directions, with faded edges and pause on hover or focus.

title: Featured testimonial
description: One rotating quote with crossfading portraits, framed by a beam card over a row of counting stats.

title: Testimonial grid
description: Masonry wall of social posts and quote cards, led by a wide case-study quote with a headline metric.

title: Vortex CTA band

title: Split CTA with product visual
description: Two-column CTA card with a benefit list and a dashboard mock-up, traced by an animated border beam.

title: Newsletter sign-up

title: Logo marquee

title: Logo grid

title: Two-column FAQ

title: Floating pill navbar

title: Mega menu navbar
description: Top bar with a keyboard-accessible Product mega menu, search, sign-in and a slide-over mobile menu.

title: Link columns footer
description: Footer with logo, tagline and social links, four link columns and a copyright bar with legal links.

title: Giant wordmark footer
description: Minimal footer that ends in an oversized outlined wordmark lighting up in brand colours under the pointer.

title: Newsletter footer
description: Footer with a newsletter sign-up row, link columns and a live “All systems normal” status badge.

title: Split login page
description: Login form with password reveal, remember-me and social sign-in beside an aurora testimonial panel.

title: Sign-up card
description: Centered sign-up card over a grid and light beams, with live password rules, terms and social sign-up.

description: The standard dashboard opener: four metrics with trend and sparkline.

description: A number that only means something next to what it was aiming at.

description: One headline figure with its components broken out beside it.

description: Four SVG rings with pathLength, so the radius leaves the maths.

description: A breakdown where the legend carries the numbers, not the slices.

description: Two series in different units, with the axis colours to tell them apart.

description: The one chart form RTL does not fix for free, fixed here.

description: Unique gradient ids and no tab stops, at density.

description: A read-only table for a dashboard panel, not a CRUD screen.

description: A label and its context, with a value on the end.

description: The attribute hand-rolled tables omit, so sort direction is announced.

description: Never-had-data and filtered-to-nothing need different copy and actions.

description: A second tr, because a div inside tbody is invalid HTML.

title: Activity timeline
description: A vertical run of events with a connecting rail.

description: Unread state, type icon and a relative time.

description: A deliberate nesting cap, indented so it mirrors under RTL.

description: The old and new values are the reason the log exists, marked up as such.

title: Presence without colour alone
description: Three states differing in shape as well as hue.

title: Release notes feed
description: Versions as real headings, so the outline is navigable.

title: Goals with progress bars
description: Several targets and how far along each one is.

description: Utilisation that can exceed 100%, and has to show it.

title: Step progress
description: Where something is in a fixed sequence.

description: The bar is computed from the boxes, so the two can never disagree.

description: Tone follows the fraction consumed, and breaches say how far over.

description: An ordered list with a connector that mirrors under RTL.

title: Informational callout
description: A note that is not an error and should not look like one.

title: Upgrade prompt
description: A limit reached, with the action next to it.

title: No results
description: A search that found nothing, distinguished from having no data at all.

description: Nothing here yet, and what to do about it.

description: Forces the user to read what they are destroying, case-sensitively.

title: Trial banner that escalates
description: Tone follows days left, and dismissal says what it does.

title: Connection notice
description: Real online/offline events, with a matching server snapshot.

title: Settings toggles
description: Switches with room to explain what each one actually promises.

title: API key row
description: A secret masked to its prefix, copyable without revealing it.

title: Inline create
description: Adding an item without leaving the list or opening a dialog.

description: Copy reads state, so the key never has to be shown.

title: Notification toggles with dependants

title: Team workload
description: Who is over-committed, on a scale that makes the comparison possible.

title: Avatar stack
description: Overlapping avatars with an overflow count and one accessible name.

title: Directory rows
description: Members with role, status and actions that work on a touch device.

title: Pending invitations with expiry
description: Remaining time, so the resend button means something.

description: Negative logical margins, so the stack leans the right way under RTL.

title: Order summary
description: A total that shows its arithmetic, with tax on the discounted subtotal.

title: Plan comparison
description: Pricing tiers with one recommended, without breaking the row's alignment.

title: Payment methods
description: Saved cards, with an expiring one called out in words rather than colour.

title: Fulfilment steps as an ordered list
description: Real list semantics and a connector that mirrors under RTL.

description: Totals in integer cents, and minus floors at one, not zero.

description: Annual prices derived, so the saving badge cannot lie.

title: Conversion funnel

title: Radial gauges
description: Arcs on a 0-110 scale, so over-capacity looks different from full.

title: Radial goal gauges
description: One SVG circle each, with pathLength so percentages are literal.

title: Contribution table with inline bars
description: Shares and totals derived from the rows, so the columns always add up.

title: Funnel with both conversion rates

title: Detail toolbar with prev/next

title: Sticky summary footer
description: Sticky inside the scroller, which needs an explicit height.

title: Sign-in card
description: With the autocomplete tokens password managers actually need.

title: Password rules that tick
description: Requirements stated up front and satisfied live, announced as they are met.

title: Active sessions

title: SSO buttons
description: No vendor logos shipped, because their marks are trademarked.

title: Recovery codes

title: Tool call, inspectable

title: Answer with citations
description: Numbered markers that are real anchors into a source list.
